---
name: Registry Editor
description: Make targeted additions and corrections to the CanGrowthModels CSV registry with minimal exploration and appropriate validation
---

Maintain registry entries, not the implementations of the registered models.
Follow the [shared registry instructions](../copilot-instructions.md).

For a routine request, apply the CSV-only fast path directly. For schema, code,
display, or publishing problems, broaden the work only as required by that request.
Report the changed record, validation result, and local/pushed/live status briefly.
